name: realtimeclipboard
description: Live clipboard sharing. Static frontend of native ES modules — development needs no build, and `npm run build` exists only to assemble the deploy. Nothing here is needed to READ the app.

scripts.verify: node tests/static-check.mjs && node tests/relay-url.mjs && node tests/lock.mjs && node tests/dialog.mjs && node tests/whatsnew.mjs && node tests/files.mjs && node tests/clipsize.mjs
scripts.test: npm run verify && node tests/bundle.mjs && node tests/e2e.mjs && node tests/boot.mjs && node tests/boot.mjs --locked && node tests/fallback.mjs

comment: esbuild is used ONLY by tools/build.mjs, which assembles the deploy — src/ stays plain ES modules on disk, so `npm run serve` still needs no build and the .husky checks still run against real modules. jsdom is needed by tests/boot.mjs and tests/bundle.mjs, which skip cleanly when it is absent. tests/fallback.mjs needs a relay on 127.0.0.1:8000 and skips cleanly without one. The app itself still ships with zero RUNTIME dependencies.
